reviewer: build-lane worker (code-grounded + live probe + acceptance validator), revision 1

rubric.evidence: Real transformers.js image-to-text in a dedicated module Worker (models/trocr-base-printed/worker.js): loadPipeline({task:"image-to-text", model:"Xenova/trocr-base-printed", backend:"wasm", dtype:"q8"}) then pipe(cropURL, {max_new_tokens, streamer}). Pre-build live probe in headless Chrome (transformers.js 3.7.5, exact shared CDN build from lib/webai.js): sample-total.png → 'GRAND TOTAL: $42.99' (2465 ms), sample-fox.png → 'THE QUICK BROWN FOX JUMPS' (2449 ms), sample-serial.png → 'SN: 487X-9021-KD' (2550 ms) — real q8 WASM output, never canned.
rubric.notes: Every route reads through the same OcrEngine worker; token streaming is a real TextStreamer callback per decoded token.

rubric.evidence: Pipeline output [{generated_text}] as expected for image-to-text; input is a single cropped line image (data URL). Probe outputs match the sample ground truth (modulo the checkpoint's SROIE uppercase normalisation, documented on the page).
rubric.notes: Semantic sanity asserted in the validator: 'GRAND TOTAL' + '$42.99' on the total sample; 'PLATFORM 9' on the sign sample.

rubric.evidence: backend wasm (pickDevice honestly falls back when no WebGPU adapter), dtype q8, model id Xenova/trocr-base-printed literal at every createModelLoader call site and in worker.js. Readout surfaces backend/tokens/ms/tok/s after each run.
rubric.notes: ~340 MB download (encoder q8 88 MB + merged decoder q8 249.6 MB + tokenizer files), measured from HF resolve headers.

rubric.evidence: createModelLoader (lib/model-loader.js + lib/model-cache.js) on all 5 routes: absent → Download; cached+current → auto-init (checking→initialising→ready, no Load button). Validator reuses one profile across cells, so cells 2..10 prove cached auto-init.
rubric.notes: Per-model clear-cache via the shared loader; dispose terminates the worker to free the WASM heap.

rubric.evidence: Progress bars + per-file status during download; worker errors post {type:'error'} → red status line on the page; Run disabled until ready; camera-denied state on wild route directs to the bundled-photo fallback.
rubric.notes: Empty-selection crop falls back to the full image; 'no text found' is an honest empty result, not a fake.

rubric.evidence: Every control driven in the validator: sample thumbnails (click), Read button, reset-crop, max-token slider (overview), editable line list + copy-all + serial workflow (practical), camera + bundled-photo fallback (wild), language select + read&translate (multi-model). All buttons have text/aria labels (hygiene assertion).
rubric.notes: Dropzone + thumbnails are keyboard-operable (Enter/Space) with focus rings.

rubric.evidence: No canned strings anywhere: the only way text reaches #textOut/#rows/#serialOut/#transOut is an engine.recognize/translate promise resolving from the worker. Validator would fail on any static output.
rubric.notes: Bundled fallback photos on the wild route are first-party samples, clearly labelled, and still run REAL inference.

rubric.evidence: role=status aria-live=polite status lines; aria-live output boxes; labelled range/select/buttons; crop canvas has an aria-label and a keyboard Reset-selection alternative; token stream is decorative-adjacent (status conveys completion).
rubric.notes: Drag-to-crop has no full keyboard box-draw — Reset + full-image default keeps the flow usable without a pointer; a future nudge-handles control would improve this (followUpGoals).

rubric.evidence: Validator asserts scrollWidth - innerWidth ≤ 1 on all 5 routes at 360×740 AND 1280×800; field-row/sample-strip flex-wrap; canvases max-inline-size 100%; 44px sample thumbs.
rubric.notes: scripts/responsive-check.mjs --slug trocr-base-printed result recorded in models.json support.

rubric.evidence: All inference + token streaming in a module worker; main thread only appends token spans. ~2.5 s/line on WASM (probe), ~20 tok/s after the encoder pass. No long-task measurement beyond the worker split yet.
rubric.notes: Base decoder is deeper than small — first-token (encode) dominates; documented on the page.

guidanceConsulted.query: drag-to-crop image region selection accessible canvas
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Canvas-rendered content must remain operable/exposed to assistive technology — provide text alternatives and non-canvas controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — the crop canvas carries an aria-label, the selection defaults to the full image, a keyboard-operable Reset-selection chip exists, and the transcribed output is real DOM text (not canvas pixels).
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CropCanvas in ocr.js; aria-label on #canvas/#serialCanvas; validator hygiene check on all routes

guidanceConsulted.query: live region streaming text output aria-live progress
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML, focus management and polite live regions for dynamic status/output updates.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — role=status aria-live=polite on every status line and output box; token-by-token stream appends spans inside an aria-live box without stealing focus.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: index/basics/practical/wild/multi-model markup; validator drives controls and asserts labelled buttons

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Request permissions only on explicit user action, explain why, minimise data, provide a no-permission path.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — camera starts only from the Start-camera button with rationale text; tracks stop on pagehide; denial surfaces an on-page error and a bundled-photo fallback that still runs real inference.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive image gallery mobile tap targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Serve appropriately sized images and keep interactive media controls touch-friendly.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — bundled samples are small first-party PNGs; thumbnails are 44px block-size with object-fit contain and keyboard activation.

openQuestions: The SROIE-tuned checkpoint normalises output to UPPERCASE — noted on the page; users wanting case-faithful OCR should know this is the model, not the page.
Drag-to-crop is pointer-first; keyboard users get full-image + reset but not a nudge-able selection box.

followUpGoals.goal: Add arrow-key nudge handles for the crop selection so keyboard users can box a line precisely.
Batch line-detection pre-pass (auto-split a receipt into line crops) feeding the base reader — a credible new multi-step demo.
